name: pharos_rhythm
description: When you and your agents work, as activity facts: one row per local clock hour, actor and top-level conversation, over the last 400 local days. Your time is estimated from the messages you typed (each preceded by its typing time, joined across the engaged gap); agent time is Parallelism's turns, attributed by the message that started each turn. Delegated agents run inside their root's turns.

fields.name: started_at
fields.label: Hour
fields.description: Start of the local clock hour. A daylight-saving day has 23 or 25 of them. Covers the last 400 local days.

fields.name: hour_of_day
fields.label: Hour of day
fields.description: Local clock hour, 00 to 23.

fields.name: actor
fields.label: Actor
fields.description: Who was active: you (your engaged time, estimated from the messages you typed), agents you started while you were engaged (with you) or not (unattended), or agents a script, schedule or another agent started (automated).

fields.name: initiator
fields.label: Started by
fields.description: Who started an agent turn, from the user message that began it: you (human), a schedule or automation sender (scheduled), a headless run (scripted), TL1 (orchestrated), another agent session (agent), or no classified message (unknown). Your own rows are human.

fields.name: automation
fields.label: Automation
fields.description: For automated turns: the automation ID of a scheduled run, the kind of headless run (claude -p, codex exec, agy -p, Claude SDK, launched by a session), or TL1.

fields.name: unit_id
fields.label: Conversation
fields.description: The top-level conversation the time belongs to: the one an agent turn ran in, or the one your message was sent to.

fields.name: unit_label
fields.label: Title
fields.description: The top-level conversation's workspace title.

fields.name: repository_name
fields.label: Repository
fields.description: Repository of the unit's top-level workspace; empty when none is recorded.

fields.name: project_name
fields.label: Project
fields.description: The unit's project: the repository, else the working folder (home as ~); empty when the session has no working directory.

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.label: Top-level conversation ID
fields.description: Set when counting agent sessions.

fields.name: provider
fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The top-level conversation's provider.

fields.name: model
fields.label: Model
fields.description: The top-level conversation's recorded model.

fields.name: channel
fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Initiating channel, inherited through the entire task tree.

fields.name: machine_id
fields.label: Machine
fields.description: Initiating location, inherited through the task tree; execution location is separate.

fields.name: machine
fields.label: Machine name
fields.description: Recorded task origin metadata.

fields.name: machine_kind
fields.label: Machine kind
fields.description: Recorded task origin metadata.

fields.name: execution_machine_id
fields.label: Execution machine
fields.description: Recorded task origin metadata.

fields.name: execution_machine
fields.label: Execution machine name
fields.description: Recorded task origin metadata.

fields.name: execution_machine_kind
fields.label: Execution machine kind
fields.description: Recorded task origin metadata.

fields.name: engaged_gap_minutes
fields.label: Engaged gap (minutes)
fields.description: Typed messages at most this many minutes apart join one engaged block, from the Habits setting.

fields.name: active_ms
fields.label: Active time (ms)
fields.description: Time this row's actor was active in this hour, in this conversation. Agent rows count each agent separately (agent-time).

fields.name: elapsed_ms
fields.label: Wall time (ms)
fields.description: Active time divided by how many agents (or, for you, conversations) were active at once. Summed over any rows of one kind it is wall-clock time, never double-counting overlap; across agent rows it partitions the time with any agent active.

fields.name: parallel_elapsed_ms
fields.label: Parallel wall time (ms)
fields.description: Wall time while two or more agents were active.

fields.name: active_hours
fields.label: Active hours
fields.description: Active time in hours.

fields.name: elapsed_hours
fields.label: Wall hours
fields.description: Wall time in hours.

fields.name: parallel_elapsed_hours
fields.label: Parallel wall hours
fields.description: Parallel wall time in hours.

fields.name: peak_level
fields.label: Peak agents at once
fields.description: The most agents active at once during this row's time; empty for your rows.

fields.name: messages
fields.label: Typed messages
fields.description: Messages with typed text you sent in this hour, to this conversation; empty for agent rows.

fields.name: typed_words
fields.label: Typed words
fields.description: Words you typed in those messages; empty for agent rows.

fields.name: turns
fields.label: Turns started
fields.description: Agent turns started in this hour; empty for your rows.
